cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to collect my things. I work Sundays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Saturday lunch buys the hallway. Your records are in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring lunch for both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That gets you the records. Stay to listen to one with me and I'll help carry the boxes.

mechanism: A grants graded home access and help only in exchange for increasingly personal time together, retaining authority over the terms of renewed closeness.
confusable: D70 general gatekeeping lacks the personal visits/listening currency that makes this a relationship ledger.
comparison: Returning belongings and hearing a record together differ from labor buying forgiveness after an argument.
seedUse: Retain D94-b Sunday limit, Saturday lunch and shared listening as progressively priced relational access.
